label: Week of 28 September
notes: Five dinners, Monday to Friday; the weekend is yours. Three Chinese stir-fries and two Spanish/Italian nights, which is the 50/50 rule as close as five divides, tilted towards what you asked for.
Kept cheap: the dearest dinner is under 11 €, and two of them (pizza, fried rice with lardons) are under 5 €.
The ginger you already have carries all three stir-fries and Thursday's cold ramen, so none goes on the order.

The last order was 15 September, twelve days ago. The kitchen list keeps only the cupboard lines from it: ginger, both soy sauces, the yakitori sauce, sugar, olive oil, paprika, rosemary, balsamic, cornichons and the coffee. Everything fresh on that receipt is taken as eaten.
Coffee is struck because the two boxes of 30 from 15 September should last until about 5 October. If the cupboard says otherwise, add it back: it is 19,55 €.
Monday's rice is cooked double. Tuesday's lunch is what's left of it.
